app.title: Call & Translate
brief.title: Call brief
brief.hint: What you need done, the facts they will ask for, and the answers you want back.
fill.title: Dictate and fill
fill.hint: Speak or type what you need done. When you stop, the words appear here so you can edit them. Then fill the brief — we’ll ask for any details the other side is likely to need.
ph.fillNotes: Extend the hotel stay two nights under Ada Lovelace, booking 4419, and get the new total plus a confirmation email.
fill.creditNotice: Dictation uses some of your remaining call time for speech-to-text. Filling the brief uses a little more for Grok. You will see how much was deducted after each step.
ph.goal: Extend the hotel stay by two nights, confirm the new total, and get a written confirmation.
ph.rules: You are calling on behalf of… Be concise. If they ask for something you don’t have, check with me on speaker.
ph.information: Name, dates, booking or account numbers — and the questions you need answered: price, hours, confirmation number…
brief.factsHint: Include what the other side will ask for, and what you want to find out.
label.discloseAi: Tell the other person an AI assistant is on speakerphone with you.
live.title: Live call
status.paused: Paused — agent is silent, call still open
title.pause: Pause the agent without ending the call
live.disclosure: Put the phone on speaker so you, the agent, and the other person can all hear each other. Follow the live transcript in your language. Jump in to correct or add a question. If they ask for something that is not in the brief, the agent will check with you.
live.emptyTranscript: Live transcript appears here. What was said on top, translation into your language underneath. Jump in anytime — if they ask for something missing, the agent will check with you.
report.title: Call report
report.empty: No report yet. End a call, then write what was said, what was done, what was captured, and anything still outstanding.
settings.title: Settings
billing.paidActive: You are on Paid (£12 / month). One hour of call time is added each billing cycle.

billing.free: You are on Free. Upgrade to Paid for £12 / month and one hour of call time.
legal.title: Legal
endCall.title: End this call?
endCall.copy: The agent will hang up and the session will close. Pause if you only need the agent to stay quiet.
followUp.title: They’ll likely ask for more
followUp.lead: The system thinks the person, business, or office you’re calling will ask for a few details that aren’t in what you said yet. The agent will be speaking on your behalf. Add them below, dictate, or skip this step and deal with it on the call when asked.
followUp.tip: The more information you give the agent now, the smoother this will go — and the shorter the call.
label.followUpSpoken: Or say it in your own words
ph.followUpSpoken: Dictate or type anything else the agent should know.
btn.skipFollowUp: Skip — I’ll deal with it on the call
followUp.creditNotice: Dictation uses some of your remaining call time for speech-to-text. Adding answers uses a little more for Grok.
ph.followUpAnswer: Type it, dictate it, or leave blank to skip this one.
